candidates.name: Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
support_spans: progressive, multiple itchy erythematous to violaceous papules and plaques localized to the left shin
milia and a few erosions with partially detached epidermis
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of progressive, itchy erythematous papules and plaques, along with milia and erosions, is consistent with Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.

candidates.name: Epidermolysis Bullosa Acquisita
support_spans: dermoepidermal separation
erosion with partially detached epidermis
candidates.why: The histopathologic examination revealing dermoepidermal separation and erosion with partially detached epidermis supports Epidermolysis Bullosa Acquisita.

candidates.name: Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
support_spans: novel heterozygous missense variant, c.6832G>T, p.Gly2278Trp, in COL7A1
candidates.why: The genetic testing identifying a novel variant in COL7A1, a gene associated with Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa, supports this diagnosis.
